name: de_all
description: Every German car in one pool: 95 cars (Porsche 30, BMW 24, Audi 20, Mercedes-Benz 8, AMG 7, VW 6) drawn into 23 slots, PI window 300..900 in steps of 20, and a progression band of -350..+250 around the player at frames 40, 80 and 100 so the grid spans several classes yet follows the player's car. Difficulty Expert, rubber banding off and the race elastic flags (slow down / catch up / proximity / position spread) off. Generation rule (TASK_g17_prep step 3, reproducible with aifield_survey + _data/cars.json): a car is in if its make is German (Porsche, BMW, Audi, Mercedes-Benz, AMG/M-AMG, VW, Opel), it is in the catalogue, it has an AI_<car>_<pi>.xml ladder, it carries no always-on veto (_data/denylist.json) and its class is E to R (so the window covers every one of them); Mercury and Merkur are Ford and never qualified, and no pre-1960 historic is in. Of the 152 German catalogue cars 57 are out: 35 without an AI_ ladder, 10 more under an always-on veto, 10 in P or X and 2 pre-1960 (2 of the ladderless are also vetoed, 3 also pre-1960) - so no Opel qualifies, its single catalogue car has no ladder. This document mixes classes on purpose: the split by class is the four de_c/de_b/de_a/de_s specs plus the player's own PI, not a document per class. Cars whose lowest AI_ file sits above the window target run stronger than the PI listed there; that is part of what the test measures, and it is noted in the kit NOTA. Target document: AIField_109310003_Gen.xml - in the live manifest with a local blob, named by exactly one override record (109310003) that no series event uses and by no GameOptions_* generator, but the install zip already carries an older edit of this document while the cache blob holds another version, so blob and install DIVERGE here (unlike the four class specs); the cache is the runtime source, and the kit NOTA has to say so.
